# Cropper.js (vendored)

* Version: **1.6.2** (pinned)
* Upstream: https://github.com/fengyuanchen/cropperjs
* Licence: MIT — see `LICENSE`

Files are served from this repository, never from a CDN, so the owner dashboard
stays inside the project's `script-src 'self'` Content-Security-Policy and keeps
working without third-party requests.

To update, replace `cropper.min.js`, `cropper.min.css` and `LICENSE` with the
files from the matching upstream release and bump the version above.
